# Emtrain

> > Emtrain is an HR compliance training platform delivering harassment prevention and workplace culture courses with advanced risk intelligence for global organizations.

Emtrain specializes in interactive compliance training focused on harassment prevention, respect culture, and workplace conduct across multiple jurisdictions. The platform offers comprehensive courses for employees and managers, along with micro-learning modules designed to drive behavior change and reduce organizational risk.

## Key Topics

- Harassment Prevention Training
- Sexual Harassment Training
- Workplace Compliance
- Manager Training
- Employee Training
- Respect Culture
- Bystander Training
- Microlessons
- State & Federal Regulations
- Canada Compliance
- California AB 1825
- New York Harassment Laws
- UK Worker Protection Act
- Australia Sex Discrimination Act
- India PoSH Act

## Core Platform & Products

- [HR Compliance Training with Advanced Risk Intelligence | Emtrain](https://emtrain.com): Emtrain homepage: HR compliance training platform with risk intelligence
- [Workplace HR & Compliance Training Courses for Employees & Managers](https://emtrain.com/products/courses): Main product page: interactive compliance courses for employees and managers
- [Emtrain Course Catalog - Emtrain](https://emtrain.com/resources/emtrain-course-catalog): Full catalog of compliance, diversity, and micro learning course offerings

## Harassment Prevention Training

- [Harassment Prevention Training - Emtrain](https://emtrain.com/harassment-prevention-training): Flagship harassment prevention training course for EEO risk reduction
- [Preventing Workplace Harassment Training Course - Emtrain](https://emtrain.com/products/courses/preventing-workplace-harassment-training): Harassment prevention course covering identification and intervention skills
- [Preventing Workplace Harassment Training — Global - Emtrain](https://emtrain.com/products/courses/international-harassment-training): Global harassment prevention training for non-US based employees

## Regional & Jurisdiction-Specific Training

- [Online Harassment Training Course for Canada - Emtrain](https://emtrain.com/products/courses/workplace-harassment-training-ca): Canadian harassment training addressing bullying and workplace violence
- [Preventing Workplace Harassment Training — UK - Emtrain](https://emtrain.com/products/courses/preventing-workplace-harassment-uk): UK Worker Protection Act and Equality Act 2010 compliance training
- [Preventing Workplace Harassment — Australia - Emtrain](https://emtrain.com/products/courses/preventing-workplace-harassment-aus): Australia Sex Discrimination Act and Respect@Work reforms training
- [Preventing Workplace Harassment Training — India - Emtrain](https://emtrain.com/products/courses/preventing-workplace-harassment-training-india): India PoSH Act compliance training for sexual harassment prevention

## Compliance Requirements & Regulations

- [Harassment Training Requirements by State & Province - Emtrain](https://emtrain.com/harassment-requirements): State and federal harassment training requirements guide for US, UK, Canada
- [California Sexual Harassment Training Requirements - Emtrain](https://emtrain.com/harassment-requirements/sexual-harassment-training-california): California AB 1825 and SB 1343 harassment training compliance guide
- [New York Sexual Harassment Training Requirements - Emtrain](https://emtrain.com/harassment-requirements/new-york): New York mandatory annual sexual harassment training requirements
- [Illinois Sexual Harassment Training Requirements - Emtrain](https://emtrain.com/harassment-requirements/illinois): Illinois SB 75 sexual harassment prevention training requirements
- [Canada Sexual Harassment Training Requirements - Emtrain](https://emtrain.com/harassment-requirements/canada): Canadian occupational health and safety harassment training requirements
- [Federal Sexual Harassment Training Requirements - Emtrain](https://emtrain.com/harassment-requirements/federal): EEOC federal harassment training guidance and state requirements

## Microlessons & Skill Development

- [Skill Building Training Microlessons for Employees and Managers](https://emtrain.com/microlessons): Comprehensive micro learning modules for skill development and behavior change
- [Client Harassment | Workplace Response Skills Training](https://emtrain.com/microlessons/difficult-situation): Microlesson on handling client harassment while maintaining workplace respect
- [Recruitment Harassment Response | HR Compliance Skills Training](https://emtrain.com/microlessons/recruitment-harassment-complaint): Microlesson on recognizing and responding to recruitment harassment
- [Social Media Harassment | Respect Skills Training](https://emtrain.com/microlessons/social-media-harassment): Microlesson on preventing and addressing digital workplace harassment
